Checkout's outbound calls to payment, product-catalog, cart, currency and shipping appear with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 and email with HTTP 200 in the returned samples; per-method client latencies are modest (averages 0.34-16.11 ms; p95 4.75-41.25 ms) (evidence 3c32e307-4cd1-4a85-99a8-d266aaf174a1-t1:7d994155-f153-4ddb-99c7-3d995307fb48; 52365e55-a98d-41db-9ff3-34849d6196fc-t2:55cacf46-9121-41ba-874b-3562eb20bb25; 12e2e155-236a-42e9-b06c-5daa6addda7c-t0:2a4dd4f9-ae8d-42df-b80a-59730b4790f3).
